description: FAULT-S4-005 Step-3 full-ledger EVIDENCE-BAR audit — shrink-only remediation register for pre-existing provenance_kind:proof anchors that do NOT carry their proof evidence (proof_state:verified + a language-clean verification.axiom_closure + sorry_count:0 + a resolving, sorry-free proof_file). Enumerated by the audit's first run: 10 of 31 proof anchors carry strong evidence; the 21 below do not. Two classes: 'phantom' (no proof_file on master) and 'no-audit' (file resolves but written/no verification block, some on native_decide). Resolution (per entry, theory-state — oppenheimer + cth, 1x1): PROVE (supply a verified, axiom-clean proof) or RECLASSIFY (provenance_kind proof -> theory|derivation). Either resolution REMOVES the entry from this register.
policy: SHRINK-ONLY. The full-ledger evidence-bar audit (scripts/check_anchor_manifest.py) HARD-FAILS if: (1) any provenance_kind:proof anchor FAILS the evidence bar and is NOT listed here (a NEW over-claim — blocked immediately: you cannot claim proven without submitting the evidence); or (2) a listed anchor now MEETS the bar (it was proved/verified — remove the stale entry). The register can only lose entries. Adding an entry is a visible, reviewed commit to this file with a tracking issue — NOT a silent CI-driven baseline raise (that silent-raise is exactly what defeated the FAULT-S4-005 ratchet). This register is a burn-down list on the clock, not a permanent allowlist.
